text: If reflection dominates the triple ratio, a meta-reputation aristocracy forms: agents specialize in reflecting on others' allocations without contributing to the first-order surfaces, reflection validator pools drift away from cross-surface competence, and the contraction property of the composite map is lost.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Possibility Loops An Operational Architecture for Computative Economics in Agent Coordination Systems (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6655138
